name: AMS-02
summary: Space magnetic spectrometer measuring positrons, antiprotons, antinuclei and other cosmic rays precisely to constrain a dark-matter contribution to antimatter.
detection_principle: A magnetic field and silicon tracking measure charge sign and rigidity; time-of-flight, Cherenkov, transition-radiation and calorimetric measurements identify particle species.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
